summary: Preview of the Premier League match between Fulham and Manchester United on 4 November 2023, Manchester United's 11th league game of the season. United come in after back-to-back 3-0 defeats to Man City and Newcastle United amid a long injury list, while Fulham sit 14th and are unbeaten in two. The note covers team news, recent form, and where to watch in India.
one_line: Preview of Fulham vs Manchester United on 4 November 2023, with United seeking to recover from two 3-0 defeats amid injuries.
key_facts: Manchester United travel to Fulham for their 11th Premier League match of the season; Fulham have not beaten United since 2019.
Manchester United lost 3-0 to Man City in the Manchester derby after a 3-match winning run in all competitions.
United then lost 3-0 to Newcastle United in the EFL Cup round of 16, ending their reign as Carabao Cup champions.
United have 5 wins and 5 defeats in the league and sit 8th; coach Erik Ten Hag still appears to have the management's backing.
Fulham have 3 wins, 3 draws and 4 defeats and sit 14th, but are unbeaten in their last two games in all competitions.
Fulham beat Ipswich Town 3-1 in the EFL Cup round of 16 and drew 1-1 with Brighton in their last Premier League match.
Casemiro was taken off at half-time against Newcastle with a new hamstring issue and will probably be out for weeks.
Other United absentees: Tyrell Malacia and Amad Diallo (knee), Lisandro Martinez (foot), Jadon Sancho (disciplinary), Luke Shaw (muscle); Victor Lindelof has a bug.
Raphael Varane and Aaron Wan-Bissaka could return for United; Marcus Rashford, Rasmus Hojlund and Bruno Fernandes may start.
Fulham's injuries include Adama Traore (thigh), Issa Diop (foot), Kenny Tete and Tosin Adarabioyo (groin); Tete, Adarabioyo and Traore may make the squad.
Rodrigo Muniz scored his first goal in the EFL Cup and may be picked over Raul Jimenez, who has not scored since joining Fulham this summer.
The match is on 4th November, 2023 at 6:00 PM IST, broadcast on Star Sports channels and streamed on Disney+ Hotstar VIP and Jio TV.
